page: Microsoft Azure E32ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization and powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor. The hardware architecture utilizes the x86_64 instruction set, delivering 16 physical cores and 32 dedicated vCPUs with a maximum clock frequency of 4.2 GHz. The CPU subsystem is equipped with a large 260 MB L3 cache and supports specialized vector and matrix instruction sets including Intel AMX (tile and int8) and AVX-512. System memory measures 256 GB, providing an 8 GB per vCPU allocation that positions this instance for memory-intensive computations. While the instance does not feature discrete GPUs, it includes 1,888 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage.

Performance metrics reflect strong capabilities across memory throughput and single-core efficiency. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 208.86 GB/sec and write bandwidth achieves 90.98 GB/sec, placing memory subsystems in the upper quartile of evaluated instances. Computational throughput demonstrates solid marks with a Geekbench single-core score of 2,061 and a multi-core score of 17,016. Advanced matrix extensions accelerate integer and low-precision AI inference, yielding 373.84 tokens per second on small 135M language model text generation. In network and file delivery tests, static web serving throughput scales to 54.13 GB/sec, while single-threaded gzip compression completes at 31.38 GB/sec. General multi-core synthetic stress-ng benchmarks and database operations sit comfortably within median expected bounds.

The E32ds_v6 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for organizations requiring high RAM density alongside fast, ephemeral storage without incurring the overhead of GPU hardware. A potential tradeoff is the absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses and reliance on hyperthreaded cores rather than entirely dedicated non-threaded sockets for its 32 vCPUs. The balance of high uncached memory bandwidth, 256 GB of memory, and fast NVMe storage makes this server well matched for in-memory key-value stores such as Redis, enterprise transactional databases, distributed caching layers, and high-volume ETL pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E32ds_v6 is a memory-optimized cloud instance powered by a 16-core, 32-vCPU Intel Xeon 8573C processor running up to 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 256 GB of RAM, representing an 8 GB per vCPU density, and bundled with 1,888 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, the instance delivers high data throughput without discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmarks highlight strong memory read speeds of 208.86 GB/sec, solid Geekbench multi-core performance of 17,016, and static web serving throughput of 54.13 GB/sec. Built-in Intel AMX and AVX-512 extensions provide robust execution for lightweight matrix math and compression routines. Balancing large memory capacity with high-speed local disk scratch space, the E32ds_v6 provides qualitative resource efficiency for memory-heavy workloads including Redis caching layers, relational database management systems, and intensive enterprise data processing.
